title: Unique Crisp Croatian Almond Wrap
description: A yeasty, crisp Croatian dish featuring almond milk and Mediterranean-friendly ingredients, wrapped in a corn husk vessel, perfect for satisfying midnight cravings.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine almond milk, yeast, and sugar, stirring to dissolve the yeast.
Add flour, olive oil, and salt to the bowl, mixing until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll each into a thin circle.
Place a corn husk on a flat surface and put a dough circle in the center of the husk.
Brush the dough with nimono simmer sauce and fold the corn husk over the dough to form a wrap.
Repeat with the remaining dough and corn husks.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and cook the wraps for 2-3 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden brown.
